scenes.say: Ever had your app freeze and wonder why? What triggers those dreaded ANRs?

scenes.label: Timeout
scenes.sub: ANRs happen when the main thread is blocked over five seconds.
scenes.say: ANRs, or Application Not Responding errors, pop up if the main thread is blocked for more than five seconds.

rows.b: Move heavy tasks off the main thread

scenes.say: To keep your app fast, use background threads for heavy work, minimize recompositions in Compose, and always profile with tools like Profiler and StrictMode.
Here's how you launch a coroutine with the IO dispatcher for database access. This keeps the main thread free and responsive.

scenes.question: Is it safe to run database queries on the main thread?
scenes.right: No, always use background threads or coroutines to avoid ANRs.
scenes.say: Quick quiz: Is it safe to run database queries on the main thread? Nope! Always use background threads or coroutines.
